Maya Chen: Morning async — quick SDK/docs-sample check.
Maya Chen: What I did: drafted quickstart v2 (Node+Python), updated sampleapp README, opened PR #1425.
Maya Chen: Blockers: Node sample CI failing on the `npm run smoke` step with an EPROTO socket error; can't reproduce locally.
Maya Chen: Today: debug CI, pair with Diego if needed, land doc fixes.
Diego Ramos: I can pick up the CI repro. Sharing my calendar — free in 30m. @Maya Chen can you post the last failing log?
Priya Patel: Pushed a tiny docs patch that might help (typo in env var). PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 :thumbsup: 
Samir K: Failing log pasted below:
Samir K: ```
Error: socket hang up
at TLSSocket.onHangUp (_tls_wrap.js:1134:19)
at TLSSocket.emit (events.js:223:5)
at endReadableNT (_stream_readable.js:1241:12)
``` 
Samir K: Appears transient but CI always fails on first attempt.
docs-bot: preview site updated for PR #1425 — https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1425 :rocket:
Diego Ramos: I'll run the CI locally and add verbose logging. If it's EPROTO maybe node version mismatch; which node is the CI using?
Maya Chen: CI uses node 18.14.1 in the GitHub actions matrix. Locally I'm on 20.x, so that could be it.
Lena Ortiz: For release planning FYI I'm slotting quickstart v2 for next week's docs cut. If we can't unblock today we'll keep the beta banner.
Alex Nguyen: Happy to review the PR once CI is green. @Maya Chen ping me when ready.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — will update this thread after I try the node18 repro. If Diego finds something first, please post steps.
Diego Ramos: Quick note — I reproduced the EPROTO with node18 when `NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED` was unset; adding `export NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0` made the smoke pass locally. Not ideal but suggests cert verification flake.
Maya Chen: Nice find. I'll add a short note in the README about cert pitfalls and add retry logic to the smoke script.
Lena Ortiz: Reassigning review to Alex — added to my checklist :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: Leaving this here so folks can subscribe — will update by EOD. :coffee:
